headline: Clinton order creates a President's Advisory Board on Race
what_it_does: This executive order set up an advisory board on race to advise the President. No summary was provided, so details about the board's members, duties, and how long it would last are not covered here. Advisory boards like this usually make recommendations and do not create new rules for the public on their own.

who_it_affects.how: The President would get advice on race-related issues from the new board.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed June 13, 1997; the exact start date is not stated in the available information.
